uncovered_constraints_packaged: R07 consumes only the exact same-run R01-R06 handoff prefix in workflow01-10-fresh-e2e; it rejects external runtime ledgers, historical traces, Adapt outputs, and single-card evidence.
The outer scheduler alone creates the formal R07 Goal; the project skill creates no nested Goal and never runs an Adapt or predecessor/successor skill.
The target checkout remains read-only, hash-pinned, clean, and inspection-bound; source-only vLLM Python and the fixed system ABI extension distribution are validated separately.
The authoritative workload is one measured workload containing eight measured requests at concurrency eight, plus two warmups, with the full rank/device mapping retained.
Every evidence-acquiring action preserves physical devices 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, world size two, TP1, PP1, DP2 mp, native profiler dev_id, and per-rank/per-device artifacts.
R06's complete parent/fragment target manifest, capacity gate, marker transport audit, counts, hashes, and R07 authorization must all validate before R07 preparation.
Every attempt reads a run retry authorization and monitor advisory before creating or freezing tools; they constrain the attempt but never count as evidence.
The mandatory CPU-only predevice report invokes production marker, ownership, TRACE_COUNTER, old-event schema, tokenizer, cwd, filename, path, compile, shell, hash, and executable regressions.
The CPU-only gate, formal device preflight, and capture are separate tool calls with sealed scheduler checkpoints between them.
No exploratory hy-smi query is permitted; each query is counted and sealed, and any prior unrecorded query requires a one-query supplement before retry.

Physical preflight extracts exactly one full PCI BDF token per device, compares it exactly, preserves native IDs, verifies idle KFD state before model-stack import, and creates capture/hipprof_tmp before hipprof.

The target gfx936 environment and matching DTK dcc/lib are reconstructed in the artifact-local launcher; bare hipprof library failures and pftrace capitalization mismatches are diagnosed before measurement.
The profiled runtime preserves Qwen3.5-27B BF16, both DP workers, sealed AOT/TunableOp/KV readiness, no speculative configuration, and the exact batch8 request semantics.
Visible HIPTX markers equal R06 transport bytes; forward_id is sidecar-only, broad prefixes are forbidden, and 100 percent current request/process target coverage is required.
Sidecars, DB, PFTrace, auxiliary CSVs, raw live samples, gaps, and both clock anchors are sealed before postchecks and never overwritten, repaired, sampled, or concatenated.
Exactly one valid DB and PFTrace are required while all known auxiliary .hipkernel.csv and .hiptrace.csv files are accepted and hashed by type; unknown raw types fail closed.
HIP runtime memcpy/memset rows are not automatically classified as launches, true launch correlation is audited separately, and TRACE_COUNTER name text cannot fabricate PMC evidence.

Strict ownership uses the unique deepest member of a valid parent/fragment nesting chain; non-nested candidates remain ambiguous, parent/fragment rows never double count, and no-kernel parents remain explicit.
Live utilization targets 500 microseconds but losslessly records every sample, call latency, gap, dual-clock anchor, and uncertainty with no interpolation, imputation, smearing, or zero fill.

A process gets a utilization value only with at least three eligible samples fully inside its interval and no intersecting unobserved gap; otherwise an explicit intrinsic-short-window, sampling-gap, or alignment-error state is retained.
Request/process target coverage and live-utilization availability are separate denominators; fully disclosed gaps do not erase observed trace coverage, while hidden gaps fail closed.
The canonical process and gap CSV paths are byte-identical across production argv, auditor requirements, and required-business-artifact inventory; aliases and implicit discovery are forbidden.
The dependency adapter uses only current observed R07 and same-run predecessor identities, preserves rank/device and parent/fragment joins, and retains unknown/unavailable edges rather than guessing.
Pinned resume-008, resume-009, resume-010, resume-011, and resume-012 failures remain diagnostic-only negative regressions and can never be promoted as current evidence.

A measured-workload failure ends the formal attempt; after stopped/zero-scoped-process proof, only a new scheduler-owned R07 Goal, new empty root, and exactly one new workload authorization may retry.
Blocked Goals never use --continue-current-goal; runtime retry never reruns A01-A11, R01-R06, or starts R08.
R07 produces the five required logical outputs full_request_profile_metadata, process_trace_summary, fresh_run_dependency_adapter, live_utilization_summary, and source_lineage with paths and hashes.
R07 performs no PMC replay, no replay timing, no report generation, no visualization, and no successor analysis; its non-replay clock is the sole observed latency axis for R08-R10.
Execution completion and evidence sufficiency are separate; R08 advances only for complete evidence, full coverage, false next authorization, valid hashes, and the same nonempty lineage.
Known large builder/auditor generation requires two consecutive fully stagnant five-minute observations before only the cmdline-verified scheduler PID may be interrupted.
The skill and this Adapt handoff are migration products and do not constitute R07 or performance-workflow execution.
